settings.label: Orientations
settings.help: Runs that are the same object at a different angle: an entity (acq, run, rec, inv), a glob (*acq-dir*), or re:<regex>. Empty = off. How they combine: QSM → Multi-orientation

settings.label: Axial Resampling
settings.help: Resample oblique acquisitions onto an axial grid when they are tilted more than the threshold. Off: reconstruct on the acquired grid with the true B0 direction

settings.label: Obliquity Threshold (°)
settings.help: Resample only data more oblique than this, in degrees

options.label: acquired
options.help: Write derivatives back on the acquired grid when the run was resampled to axial (default)

options.label: working
options.help: Leave derivatives on the resampled (axial) working grid, avoiding a second interpolation

settings.label: Inhomog. Correction
settings.help: Apply B1 field correction to magnitude (improves masking, ROMEO weights, MEDI edges, SWI)

settings.label: Sigma (mm)
settings.help: Smoothing sigma of the bias-field estimate, in mm

settings.label: Ignore Slice Gap
settings.help: Reconstruct even if the sidecar's SliceThickness is thinner than the slice pitch (gapped 2D data gives a wrong map)

settings.label: Crop to Mask
settings.help: Run the FFT-bound stages on a box around the mask (faster; outputs stay on the full grid). Off by default

settings.label: Crop Margin (mm)
settings.help: Margin around the mask; below ~32 mm results start to differ, and it must clear the largest SMV kernel

settings.label: FFT Padding
settings.help: Pad the grid to an FFT-friendly size before the FFT-bound stages (faster on awkward grids; shifts results slightly). Off by default

settings.label: Coil Comb. Sigma
settings.help: MCPC-3D-S smoothing of per-coil phase offsets, voxels (x y z); only for uncombined multi-coil data

settings.label: Mask
settings.help: The mask recipe: one or more sections, each an input image, a generator and its refinements, combined with OR or AND

settings.label: Combined With
settings.help: How the sections are combined: OR keeps a voxel any section keeps, AND only one every section keeps

options.label: OR
options.help: A voxel is in the mask when any section keeps it

options.label: AND
options.help: A voxel is in the mask when every section keeps it

settings.label: Combined Mask Steps
settings.help: Refinement steps run on the combined mask, after the sections are combined

settings.label: Use custom masks
settings.help: BYO mask from BIDS derivatives: empty=off, * =any tool, or a tool name (e.g. bet); falls back if absent

settings.label: Two-pass Artefact Reduction
settings.help: Reconstruct again on a mask whose holes are left unfilled and keep that result where it is defined — keeps streaking from strong sources out of the rest of the brain, at roughly double the reconstruction time (doi:10.1002/mrm.29048)

settings.label: Smoothness
settings.help: BET surface smoothness factor (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Gradient Threshold
settings.help: BET gradient threshold, -1 to 1 (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Iterations
settings.help: BET surface evolution iterations (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Subdivisions
settings.help: BET icosphere subdivision level (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Reliable Mask
settings.help: The mask the second pass reconstructs on: its holes are left unfilled. Empty = the main mask without its hole filling

settings.label: Motion Correction
settings.help: Rigidly co-register every echo onto a reference echo before any other stage (multi-echo, needs magnitude). Off by default

settings.label: Reference
settings.value_help: 1-based echo number the others are aligned onto

options.label: first
options.help: Align every echo onto the first (best SNR; the published procedure) (default)

options.label: last
options.help: Align every echo onto the last

options.label: echo
options.help: Align every echo onto a given echo (Reference Echo)

settings.label: Chain
settings.help: Seed each echo's registration from its neighbour's solution

settings.label: Chain Levels
settings.help: Pyramid levels for a seeded registration (default 3)

settings.label: Min NCC
settings.help: NCC below which a registration is reported as suspect (0.3 for echoes; ~0.9 for repeats)

settings.label: Levels
settings.help: Pyramid levels: the capture range; do not lower (default 5)

settings.label: Max Samples
settings.help: Voxels sampled per metric evaluation, per level

settings.label: Max Evaluations
settings.help: Metric evaluations across all levels (hard stop)

settings.label: Tolerance
settings.help: Relative cost improvement per cycle that counts as converged

settings.label: Rotation Step (deg)
settings.help: Initial rotation step at the finest level

settings.label: Translation Step (mm)
settings.help: Initial translation step at the finest level

settings.label: Min Overlap
settings.help: Smallest fraction of sampled voxels that must overlap

options.label: romeo
options.help: ROMEO region-growing unwrapping

options.label: laplacian
options.help: Laplacian phase unwrapping (FFT-based)

options.label: dct
options.help: Unweighted least squares, Neumann-boundary DCT solve (Ghiglia & Romero 1994; QSM.jl :dct) (default)

options.label: fft
options.help: Schofield & Zhu sin/cos Laplacian, FFT solve on a zero-padded volume

settings.label: FFT Pad (voxels)
settings.help: Zero-padding per side: one value for every axis or three (x y z). Default: 64

settings.label: Phase Offset Removal
settings.help: Remove spatially-varying phase offset using HIP (Eckstein et al., 2018); multi-echo only

settings.label: Sigma
settings.help: Gaussian smoothing sigma in voxels (x y z)

settings.label: Bipolar Correction
settings.help: Remove the linear phase artefact of bipolar readout gradients (needs at least 3 echoes; fewer: skipped)

settings.label: Individual Mode
settings.help: Unwrap each echo independently (recommended). Off = template-based temporal unwrapping.

settings.label: Template Echo
settings.help: Echo used for spatial unwrapping, counted from 0 (--romeo-template counts from 1)

settings.label: Phase Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by neighbour phase coherence

settings.label: Phase Gradient Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by inter-echo phase-gradient consistency (multi-echo)

settings.label: Mag Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by neighbor magnitude coherence

settings.label: Mag Weight 2
settings.help: Penalise abnormally high signal / flow artefacts (off by default)

settings.label: Best-path Weights
settings.help: Use Abdul-Rahman best-path weights instead of ROMEO weights

settings.label: Temporal Uncertain
settings.help: Re-unwrap voxels whose temporal unwrapping is uncertain
settings.value_help: Quality threshold (0, 1] below which a voxel is re-unwrapped

settings.label: Correct Regions
settings.help: Shift each region's median to nearest 0 by n·2π

settings.label: Wrap Addition
settings.help: Extra phase tolerance beyond π for neighbor differences [0,π]

options.label: weighted-avg
options.help: Weighted average of phase/TE across echoes (default)

options.label: linear-fit
options.help: Magnitude-weighted linear fit of phase vs TE

options.label: robust-fit
options.help: Motion-robust linear fit (IRLS): down-weights echoes departing from a straight line, per voxel. Needs 4 echoes (3 without offset)

options.label: phase-snr
options.help: mag × TE — optimal for phase SNR (default)

options.label: phase-var
options.help: mag² × TE² — based on phase variance

options.label: average
options.help: Uniform weights (unweighted average)

options.label: tes
options.help: TE only

options.label: mag
options.help: Magnitude only

options.label: assumed-decay
options.help: Fixed TE·exp(−TE/T2*) per echo from an assumed T2* (no T2* map, no magnitude); phase-snr is generally better

settings.label: Assumed T2* (ms)
settings.help: T2* assumed to compute the fixed echo weights; no T2* map is used (default: 40 ms)

settings.label: Estimate Offset
settings.help: Fit a phase-offset term in the echo-time fit (robust fit: needs 4 echoes with it, 3 without)

settings.label: Reliability Mask
settings.help: Report the fit's reliability mask; does not change the field map
settings.value_help: Percentile of the fit residual above which a voxel counts as unreliable

options.label: tukey
options.help: Tukey biweight: rejects an echo at a voxel past the tuning radius (default)

options.label: huber
options.help: Huber: caps an outlying echo's influence but never rejects it

settings.label: Tuning
settings.help: Tuning radius in robust-scale units; blank = conventional (Tukey 4.685, Huber 1.345)

settings.label: Iterations
settings.help: IRLS passes (0 = report only: the field map is the linear fit's)

settings.label: Downweight Level
settings.help: Reporting only: a weight below this counts as down-weighted (0, 1]

settings.label: Flag Ratio
settings.help: Reporting only: flag an echo whose outlier score exceeds this x the best echo's (>= 1)

options.label: vsharp
options.help: Variable-kernel SHARP (V-SHARP)

options.label: pdf
options.help: Projection onto Dipole Fields (PDF)

options.label: lbv
options.help: Laplacian Boundary Value (LBV)

options.label: ismv
options.help: Iterative Spherical Mean Value (iSMV)

options.label: sharp
options.help: SHARP (Sophisticated Harmonic Artifact Reduction)

options.label: resharp
options.help: Regularized SHARP (RESHARP) with Tikhonov

options.label: harperella
options.help: HARPERELLA integrated unwrap+BFR

options.label: iharperella
options.help: Improved HARPERELLA (iHARPERELLA) — Li et al., Proc. ISMRM 2015, p.3313

options.label: bfrnet
options.help: BFRnet deep-learning background removal (weights auto-downloaded)

options.label: iqfm
options.help: iQFM deep-learning joint unwrapping + background removal from phase (weights auto-downloaded)

settings.label: Deconvolve
settings.help: Undo the SMV high-pass with a truncated-SVD deconvolution (default: off)

options.label: native
options.help: The acquired voxel grid (default)

options.label: finest
options.help: An isotropic grid at the smallest voxel dimension, so no axis is coarsened; isotropic data stays on the acquired grid

options.label: isotropic
options.help: An isotropic grid of Grid Spacing mm; the background is interpolated back, the local field keeps native resolution

settings.label: mSMV refinement
settings.help: Remove residual boundary-field shadows with mSMV after the primary BFR (Roberts 2024)

settings.label: mSMV Radius
settings.help: SMV prefilter kernel radius in mm

settings.label: Compute QSM
settings.help: Enable QSM reconstruction (disable to only run the other outputs)

options.label: rts
options.help: RTS (Rapid Two-Step) — fast two-step k-space inversion with streaking removal.

options.label: tv
options.help: TV-ADMM (Total Variation) — ADMM inversion with a total-variation prior.

options.label: tkd
options.help: TKD (Thresholded K-space Division) — direct k-space division with thresholding.

options.label: tsvd
options.help: TSVD (Truncated SVD) — zeroes the small singular values of the dipole kernel.

options.label: tgv
options.help: TGV (Total Generalized Variation) — single-step: unwrapping, background removal and inversion together.

options.label: tikhonov
options.help: Tikhonov — closed-form L2-regularized inversion.

options.label: nltv
options.help: NLTV (Nonlinear Total Variation) — nonlinear data fidelity with a TV prior.

options.label: medi
options.help: MEDI (Morphology Enabled Dipole Inversion) — magnitude-guided edge weighting.

options.label: tfi
options.help: TFI (Total Field Inversion) — inverts the total field directly (its own background removal).

options.label: ilsqr
options.help: iLSQR (default) — iterative LSQR with streaking-artifact correction.

options.label: lsqr
options.help: LSQR (minimally regularised) — one least-squares solve for χ plus a residual field; the residual weight is the only regularisation.

options.label: heidi
options.help: HEIDI (Homogeneity Enabled Incremental Dipole Inversion) — keeps the well-conditioned k-space of an LSQR solve and re-derives the dipole cone under a homogeneity prior.

options.label: qsmart
options.help: QSMART — two-stage spatially-dependent filtering plus inversion.

options.label: ndi
options.help: NDI (Nonlinear Dipole Inversion) — gradient-descent nonlinear fit.

options.label: fansi
options.help: FANSI (Nonlinear TV) — fast nonlinear susceptibility inversion with a TV prior.

options.label: fansi-tgv
options.help: FANSI (Nonlinear TGV) — FANSI with a total-generalized-variation prior.

options.label: l1qsm
options.help: L1-QSM (L1 Data Fidelity) — L1 fidelity for streaking suppression.

options.label: whqsm
options.help: WH-QSM (Weak-Harmonic QSM) — jointly fits a residual harmonic background field.

options.label: hdqsm
options.help: HD-QSM (Hybrid Data Fidelity) — combined L1/L2 data fidelity.

options.label: amp-pe
options.help: AMP-PE (Approximate Message Passing with Parameter Estimation) — self-tuning Bayesian inversion.

options.label: xqsm
options.help: xQSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — octave-convolution U-net dipole inversion.

options.label: qsmnet
options.help: QSMnet (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — 3D U-net dipole inversion.

options.label: qsmnet-plus
options.help: QSMnet+ (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — QSMnet trained for a wider susceptibility range.

options.label: autoqsm
options.help: AutoQSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — single-step reconstruction, no separate background removal.

options.label: qsmgan
options.help: QSMGAN (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — GAN-refined U-net dipole inversion.

options.label: ir2qsm
options.help: IR2QSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — iterative unrolled U-net inversion.

options.label: lpcnn
options.help: LPCNN (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — learned-proximal unrolled inversion.

options.label: modl-qsm
options.help: MoDL-QSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — model-based unrolled inversion (χ33/STI).

options.label: nextqsm
options.help: NeXtQSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — single-step reconstruction, no separate background removal.

options.label: iqsm
options.help: iQSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — end-to-end reconstruction from wrapped phase.

options.label: iqsm-plus
options.help: iQSM+ (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — orientation-adaptive end-to-end reconstruction.

settings.label: Alpha1
settings.help: First-order TGV weight (gradient term), in ppm

settings.label: Alpha0
settings.help: Second-order TGV weight (symmetric gradient term), in ppm

settings.label: SMV Mode
settings.help: MEDI handles background removal internally using spherical mean value preprocessing (skips the BG removal step)

settings.label: MERIT
settings.help: Iteratively down-weight voxels whose residual stays large

options.label: uniform
options.help: Every voxel of the field weighs the same in the data term

options.label: magnitude SNR
options.help: Weight the data term by the magnitude SNR, so noisy voxels count for less

settings.label: Precond
settings.help: Preconditioner value (susceptibility scaling outside the mask)

settings.label: MERIT
settings.help: Iteratively down-weight voxels whose residual stays large

options.label: uniform
options.help: Every voxel of the field weighs the same in the data term

options.label: magnitude SNR

settings.label: Pad (mm)
settings.help: Zero-padding per side, mm. Larger costs time and memory; below 16 mm thin volumes lose accuracy

settings.label: Residual Weight
settings.help: Weight w on the residual field — the only regularisation. Blank = scaled from B0; 0 drops the term and streaks badly

settings.label: Fit Global Offset
settings.help: Fit a single global field offset alongside χ

settings.label: Cone Threshold
settings.help: |D(k)| above which a coefficient is taken from the LSQR seed unchanged

settings.label: Gradient Threshold
settings.help: Field-gradient threshold (ppm/mm); below it a direction reads as homogeneous

settings.label: Laplacian Correction
settings.help: Open the homogeneity masks where the field's Laplacian is large

settings.label: Gradient Mask Floor
settings.help: TV weight kept where every direction reads as an edge (0 = upstream's binarised masks)

settings.label: Continuation Steps
settings.help: NESTA continuation steps on μ. The dominant quality knob, and more is not better — worth sweeping

settings.label: HEIDI Tolerance
settings.help: Relative objective change that ends an inner loop early

settings.label: Denoise Field
settings.help: Anisotropic-diffusion smoothing of the field before its gradients are taken

settings.label: mIP Window
settings.help: Minimum intensity projection window size in slices

settings.label: Compute SMWI
settings.help: Susceptibility map-weighted imaging — weights the magnitude by a mask built from χ, not from filtered phase. Needs QSM

settings.label: Threshold
settings.help: |χ| in ppm at which the weighting mask reaches zero. The 1 ppm default targets strong sources; brain tissue wants far less

settings.label: Power
settings.help: Power the mask is raised to (contrast strength)

settings.label: Compute T2* Map
settings.help: Compute T2* relaxation map (requires 3+ echoes with magnitude)

settings.label: Compute R2* Map
settings.help: Compute R2* decay rate map (requires 3+ echoes with magnitude)

settings.label: Compute R2 Map
settings.help: R2 map (Hz) from a multi-echo spin-echo (MESE) acquisition via EPG. Forced on when chi-separation needs it

settings.label: Custom R2 tool
settings.help: Use an R2 map from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing it from MESE (blank = compute, * = any tool)

settings.label: Compute R2' Map
settings.help: R2' = R2* − R2 (Hz); needs GRE magnitude + a MESE acquisition, or R2PRIMEnet. Forced on when chi-separation needs it

settings.label: Custom R2' tool
settings.help: Use an R2' map from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing it (blank = compute, * = any tool)

options.label: auto
options.help: Measure R2' = R2* - R2 from a MESE acquisition when one is present, else predict it from R2* with R2PRIMEnet

options.label: mese
options.help: Only ever measure R2' from a MESE acquisition - produces no R2' without spin-echo data

options.label: r2primenet
options.help: Always predict R2' from R2* with R2PRIMEnet, even when a MESE acquisition is available (an estimate, not a measurement)

settings.label: R2PRIMEnet off 3 T
settings.help: Run R2PRIMEnet on non-3 T data (trained at 3 T only; the R2' is uncalibrated). Off: auto skips R2', r2primenet errors

settings.label: R2PRIMEnet Patch
settings.help: Sliding-window patch D H W in voxels, each a multiple of 16 (default 192 192 128)

settings.label: Segmentation
settings.help: Whole-brain parcellation: SynthSeg straight off the GRE magnitude, or one supplied in derivatives. Forced on by the statistics and a region reference

settings.label: Derivatives tool
settings.help: The dseg from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/: * = any tool, or a tool name; SynthSeg runs where none is found

options.label: v1
options.help: v1: 32 labels, weights ship with SynthSeg. v2: 33 labels (adds CSF); its weights are not published yet, so a run with v2 is refused unless synthseg-2.0.onnx is in $QSM_MODEL_DIR

options.label: v2
options.help: v1: 32 labels, weights ship with SynthSeg. v2: 33 labels (adds CSF); its weights are not published yet, so a run with v2 is refused unless synthseg-2.0.onnx is in $QSM_MODEL_DIR

settings.label: Crop
settings.help: Cubic centre-crop in voxels at 1 mm before inference; empty processes the whole volume

settings.label: Flip Averaging
settings.help: Average with a left-right flipped second pass (SynthSeg's default). Doubles inference time

settings.label: Topology Cleanup
settings.help: Reset each topological class to its largest connected component

settings.label: Posterior Smoothing
settings.help: Gaussian blur on the posteriors before the labels are taken
settings.value_help: Gaussian sigma of the posterior blur, in voxels

settings.label: Per-structure statistics
settings.help: Summarise every map the run makes (χ, χ+/χ−, T2*, R2*, R2, R2') per structure into a TSV: mean, SD, median, min, max, 5th/95th percentiles. Implies segmentation; implies QSM only if no other map is enabled

settings.label: Export DICOM
settings.help: Also write final maps as DICOM series into each subject's extra_files/ folder
